reusable_rules.rule: Every alert episode on an included date gets its own city+date+local-window search. A date is not complete after one attack is found.
reusable_rules.purpose: Recover secondary attacks on multi-episode dates.

reusable_rules.rule: Maintain episode-level searched/completed state. Continue until every episode on the date is marked source-hit or no-source-hit.

If ordinary web/news search lacks episode-specific evidence, query indexed Telegram generically with city+date+hour+lexical variants, without seeding a known channel. If a channel surfaces, inspect neighboring messages around the alert.
reusable_rules.purpose: Recover short Telegram-only evidence and chronology.

reusable_rules.rule: Assemble neighboring contemporaneous messages into aerial threat -> explosion/impact -> PVO/clarification chains when timing and locality support one attack.
reusable_rules.purpose: Use PVO as context without treating PVO alone as explosion evidence.

reusable_rules.rule: When search results are dominated by another same-day event, query outlet date/tag/archive or live chronology pages and scan the target hour.
For dense attack dates, inspect live-blog or time-stamped chronology bodies and extract clock-stamped updates, not only standalone article titles.

Open relevant articles and inspect full body for explicit or approximate event time expressions: о HH:MM, близько, після, до цього, за кілька хвилин, вранці/ввечері. Snippet/title is insufficient when multiple alerts exist.
reusable_rules.purpose: Attribute found attacks to the correct episode.

reusable_rules.rule: Never substitute article/message publication time for event time. Attribute using explicit event time, contemporaneous-live wording, explicit alert relation, or an unambiguous evidence chain.
On multi-episode dates, generic 'during the alert' wording cannot select an episode unless chronology is episode-specific. Otherwise needs_review/episode_ambiguous.
Classify discovery evidence as PVO_ONLY, PVO_PLUS_EXPLOSION, or PVO_CHAIN_SUPPORT. PVO_ONLY never satisfies explosion strictness.
reusable_rules.purpose: Keep broad PVO recall without false positives.

pvo_distinction.PVO_ONLY: PVO/air-defence activity with no exact-city explosion/impact evidence. Discovery context only; cannot be strict.
pvo_distinction.PVO_PLUS_EXPLOSION: Exact-city explosion/impact evidence plus PVO/aerial-war context. Can support strict only with target-episode attribution.
pvo_distinction.PVO_CHAIN_SUPPORT: Threat/PVO messages that connect neighboring exact-city explosion/impact messages into one chronology; support only, not standalone evidence.
